lead: An `--ORACLE-DIVERGES--` block is *one line*, however long the prose is.
body: The harness answers `not a valid case: line 3: `--ORACLE-DIVERGES--` is one line` and refuses the whole file, so a divergence written as paragraphs has to be folded into one. Write it as one line from the start with a capitalised lead-in (`THE INTEGER BAND:`) where a heading would have earned a break; `json-decode-refuses-the-number-band-json_decode-degrades.nvst` is the worked shape.
